propositions: _check_work_landed unconditionally calls _referencing_commits before checking file_impact, causing unnecessary full git log scans and ticket resolution on no-impact closes

Tickets closed with file_impact=[] and no accepted descendants currently spend minutes scanning repository history and resolving historical ticket references despite being out of scope for landing checks
_check_work_landed should return early when the union of ticket and accepted descendant file_impact is empty, before invoking commit discovery
Tickets with nonempty file_impact or accepted descendants with file impact must continue to invoke commit discovery and existing landing enforcement
The fix preserves completion-verifier, administrative-disposition, descendant-credit, and force semantics while skipping unnecessary history scans only when accepted-scope impact is empty
